verdict.rationale: LlamaParse is API-first. Its docs describe a REST API alongside SDKs for Python, TypeScript, Go, Java and C#, plus a CLI, all on one API key. Every product (Parse, Extract, Classify, Split, Index) is exposed as a separate API, with code samples and webhooks for job-status notifications. Missing for 10: no machine-readable OpenAPI spec at the probed paths, and no independent or hands-on corroboration of the API specifically.
